deliberations:
MIN 01/Q4/26 — Adoption of Previous Minutes:
The minutes of the previous strategy meeting held on 15th September 2026 were reviewed and unanimously adopted as a true and accurate record.

MIN 02/Q4/26 — Cloud Platform & Supabase Migration:
David Mwangi presented the comprehensive architecture blueprint for the Next.js and Supabase enterprise migration. The board reviewed security audits, RLS policies, and agreed to approve the infrastructure capital budget of KES 2.5M.

MIN 03/Q4/26 — Payment Gateway Failover:
Mercy Achieng reported that transaction volume exceeded KES 150M in Q3. The board resolved to mandate dual-redundancy M-Pesa endpoints to maintain 99.98% platform reliability.
